answer: Each agent identity is bound to an SGX enclave with TPM-rooted keys and a zero-knowledge attestation of code, hardware clock, and policy state. The yarrow state tree commits measurements, tundra is the VDF-based liveness anchor, and pigment is the consensus contract recording bonds. Forging identities requires compromising distinct hardware or solving each VDF; bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve and are irreversibly slashed on equivocation.
